messages:
Lina Gomez: Hi! Unboxing my kit now monitor arrived but it's missing the power brick (only the USB-C cable was in the box). Also my new wireless keyboard's backlight keeps flickering when I plug the USB receiver into the dock. Ticket created: IT-4521. Who should I tag? :confused:

Miles (IT): Hey Lina, sorry about that mix-up. Tagging myself. Can you confirm the monitor brand/model on the shipping label? For the keyboard, what's the receiver model (tiny dongle sticker) and does the flicker happen when plugged into a wall USB-A adapter too?

Lina Gomez: Shipping label: "AOC 24V4X". Receiver says "LogiR-001". Flicker happens only when receiver is in the dock's front USB-C port; if I plug the receiver into the laptop's side USB-A via an adapter it's stable. I'm using the provided USB-C dock (part #RD-DK100).

OnboardingBot: IT-4521 created and assigned to Miles (IT). Missing part: monitor power brick flagged. Spare power bricks in IT stock: search PB-AOC-24. Estimated courier dispatch: 2 business days.

Miles (IT): Thanks. Sounds like the dock's passthrough power/USB negotiation is flaky. Quick workaround: use the laptop USB-A adapter for the receiver and I'll swap the dock if we can't repro. Can you plug the dock into a different outlet and run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and paste the related line? Also try a different USB-C cable if you have one.

Lina Gomez: Ran `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and see: "LogiR-001: Manufacturer: Logitech
Product ID: 0xc52f
Current Available (mA): 500". Tried alternate outlet and a spare cablesame flicker. Happy to use the laptop adapter for now. Thanks for the quick help! :smile:

Nora (People Ops): Welcome Lina! If you want a temporary power brick we can drop one off today from campus supplies. Also stop by for a welcome snack this afternoon :tada:

Miles (IT): OK I'll ship a replacement monitor power brick today and pull a dock off inventory for testing. If the dock swap doesn't fix the flicker we'll replace the keyboard receiver. I'll update IT-4521 with tracking.
